target_customer: Partner companies that hire a think-tank to develop technology-based ideas, products and services
problem: Companies needed outside help turning new technologies into market-ready products. 3dot offered brainstorming and idea refinement as a service.
business_model: consulting and think-tank services for partner companies (from the YC description; no revenue data found)
product_category: technology think-tank and product ideation services

founders.name: Michael Douglas
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no education or earlier employers.

founders.name: Euwyn Poon
prior_employers: Simpson Thacher & Bartlett (M&A lawyer, per YC page)
previous_startups: Spin (acquired by Ford, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: From the YC founder bio. Order of his roles relative to 3dot is not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: A think-tank service has no stated core technology. The work was ideation and prototyping for partners.

defensibility.rationale: Consulting services built on people and ideas are easy to copy and carry no data, network or regulatory moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source mentions any incumbent reaction. Consulting and design agencies already offered similar services but none are documented against 3dot.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand was found. The company describes partner companies as customers but names none.

branding.domain_note: The YC page lists 3dot.com as the website; no source on acquisition of the domain was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or brand material was found. Several unrelated companies use near-identical names (3dots, 3dot d.o.o., Three Dot Designs), which makes the name confusable.

outcome_analysis: 3dot was a two-person Ljubljana think-tank in YC Winter 2015 that sold ideation and product development to partner companies. The YC directory lists it as inactive, but no shutdown date, funding history or post-mortem was found, so the cause of its end is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Company website 3dot.com could not be fetched in this session (network allowlist), so it is not confirmed dead. A Kando funding table lists a Seed round with Y Combinator as the only investor but no amount or date was visible, and the page was garbled, so no round is recorded. Altss lists only two of the three YC founders. Exit type shutdown rests only on YC Inactive status. A separate Slovenian firm, 3dot d.o.o. (3dot.net), is a business-process consultancy and may be unrelated.
